head: Duo Paint app: mix real-looking colors and paint on iPhone and iPad
dek: Duo Paint is a $2.99 painting app for iPhone and iPad where you mix colors in wells, then paint with brushes or a spatula on different surfaces. It was #50 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 23 November.
details: You can start on a blank canvas or a ready-made picture, change brush size and opacity, save brush presets, undo and wipe paint off with a cloth, and sign your work. Paintings stay editable in a gallery inside the app and can be saved to Photos, exported as PNG files, shared or printed. It needs no account, works offline and keeps your paintings on the device. Made by Ralph Nicolas, it came out on 16 November and needs iOS 17 or later.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later), App Store, $2.99
means: If you like painting but don't want paints and cleanup, this app gives you mixing and brush work on a phone or tablet for a one-time price.
todo: Export the paintings you want to keep: the listing warns that deleting the app or its data can remove saved work.
thumb_words: DUO PAINT: MIX COLORS, THEN PAINT
